name: University of Lausanne
description: The University of Lausanne (UNIL) is a public university in Lausanne, founded as an academy in 1537 and a university since 1890. It has seven faculties, including HEC Lausanne, law, biology and medicine, and teaches mainly in French.
whyIncluded: The University of Lausanne is among the 10 universities in Switzerland most chosen by international students (about 23% of its 14,645 students are international, per Times Higher Education World University Rankings 2027 data), per the FinexisEdu shortlist research of October 2026.

livingCosts.summary: The university's own basic student budget per month, using the middle of its ranges. Day-to-day costs such as transport are inside its living and food figure. Excludes health insurance and fees.
livingCosts.notes: UNIL 'Taxes d'etudes et cout de la vie' page: basic student budget about CHF 2,050 a month = living and food CHF 850-900, accommodation CHF 700-900, health and accident insurance CHF 150-300, books and course material CHF 100-150. Midpoints used: housing 800; food 875 (UNIL's combined 'living and food' line, which also covers everyday costs such as local transport, so transport is 0 rather than double counted); personal 125 (books and course material). Insurance excluded. Months = 12 because the budget is monthly with no academic-year length. Page undated, read 2026-10-07.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Management (HEC Lausanne)
programmes.summary: Yearly course and semester fees, the same for Swiss and international students. A one-off CHF 200 application processing fee applies to applicants with foreign qualifications.
programmes.notes: UNIL immatriculation page 'Taxes d'etudes et cout de la vie': 'Bachelor, Master, EFLE: CHF 580.- per semester' (course enrolment + semester fees combined), no surcharge for foreign students, so CHF 580 x 2 = 1,160. No separate compulsory contributions listed. One-off: CHF 200 administrative fee for processing applications from bachelor applicants with a foreign secondary certificate and master applicants without a Swiss university degree (https://unil.ch/immat/en/home/menuinst/futurs-etudiants/sinscrire.html). Page undated, read 2026-10-07; feeYear 2026 is the current rate. No 2024/2025 rows: no dated UNIL or Vaud source for those years was found this session (the fee has long been CHF 580 but that is not documented here). 3-year (180 ECTS) HEC Lausanne bachelor, taught mainly in French.
